evals.prompt: O design da landing está pronto em docs/design/screens/landing-page (HTML exportado do Claude Design). Gera a spec para implementar.
evals.expected_output: The export is unpacked with scripts/unpack_export.py; the spec separates the tool runtime, the inlined library copy and preview switches (such as a hard-coded reduced-motion flag) from what ships; every invented custom property and fixed colour has a Tokens row with an action; every region of SCREEN-1 has a component with its content source; motion timings are read from the script; deviations against the specs have actions; lint ok; the reply is in Portuguese.
assertions: scripts/unpack_export.py is run and its inventory.json is used
The spec names the preview-only switches found in the script
Every invented custom property of the inventory is covered by a Tokens row
Motion rows carry numbers from the script and a reduced-motion rule
scripts/lint_handoff.py with --inventory and --library reports ok: true
